analyst: Manual analysis using Claude Opus 5.5 for verification and code analysis

servers.docs_used: No official documentation; https://claude.com/connectors/tripadvisor (connector card); https://mcpservers.org/remote-mcp-servers/tripadvisor (third-party catalogue)
servers.server_cost: No price given; connector available in Claude (web, desktop, mobile, Code, API)
servers.restrictions: Endpoint returns 403 without sign-in (CSV); authorization method not documented
servers.governance_logic: Clarification of ambiguous places before searching; read only, no booking; everything else not documented.
servers.structure_note: According to the available information; hosted on a separate platform ("ai-mcp-extensibility" on tamg.cloud) behind mcp.tripadvisor.ai
servers.actions_comment: Not published; 4 functions according to the description (hotel search, hotel details, prices and availability, places nearby)
servers.agent_cannot: Book; work with restaurants and attractions (hotels only); write reviews; manage Trips.
servers.gov_promises: Practically none; the privacy policy in the connector card is the 2019 version.
servers.user_promises: "Find your perfect hotel based on Tripadvisor reviews", "ground accommodation planning in real-time data and other travelers' opinions"
servers.promises_vs_logic: Cannot be compared (no documentation, closed code)
servers.notes: CSV has no documentation link. The catalogue gives a different address: https://production.ai-mcp-extensibility-prd.tamg.cloud/ogMvjY4De1G7CiHanMOAgddl/mcp (tamg = TripAdvisor Media Group). Unofficial tripadvisor-mcp servers on GitHub (pab1it0, hhw67865) not included. Support: TripadvisorDataSupport@tripadvisor.com.

Tools.desc: Read only ("Read (listed as read-only)", "Interactive"): hotel search in an area; details, photos, reviews, ratings, availability, prices, places nearby; tools work with location/hotel IDs

Authorization.desc: Not documented; OAuth metadata not available

Elicitation.desc: Elicitation-like behaviour according to the description: for an ambiguous place ("Springfield") the connector asks for clarification before searching; mechanism not stated

Other.desc: "Interactive" label on the connector card - probably an interactive interface (MCP Apps?) in the client window

actions.desc: Search for hotels in an area (asks for clarification of ambiguous place names)
Get hotel details: photos, reviews, ratings

observations.text: Minimal transparency: an official server without documentation; the address from the CSV is a facade over hosting on another domain.
A server in the vendor's interest: results rely on Tripadvisor ratings and reviews; how hotels are ranked (incl. possible paid placements) is not described.
